Columbus is a growing city with a vibrant mix of homes, apartments, and businesses. 1-800-GOT-JUNK? tailors its service to fit the unique needs of this market, delivering several key advantages:

  • Transparent pricing: No hidden fees; you see the price before the truck arrives.
  • Speed and reliability: Same‑day or next‑day appointments are common.

Community Commitment

In Columbus, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? partners with local charities such as Goodwill and Habitat for Humanity. By choosing the service, you’re indirectly supporting community programs that provide jobs and resources to those in need.

How the Service Works

The process is intentionally simple—just three steps from start to finish:

1. Schedule Your Pickup

Call or use the online form to set a date and time that works for you. Columbus residents often appreciate the flexibility of early‑morning or late‑evening slots, especially if you’re juggling work or school schedules.

2. Get a Real‑Time Estimate

When the truck arrives, a friendly crew member evaluates the load and confirms the price on the spot. This “no‑guesswork” approach means you never pay more than what you were quoted.

3. Watch the Junk Vanish

The team loads everything into their truck, handles all the heavy lifting, and leaves your space clean. In most cases, the work is completed within an hour.

Pricing and What’s Included

1-800-GOT-JUNK? follows a volume‑based pricing model. The driver measures the amount of space your junk occupies in the truck, then multiplies that by a per‑cubic‑foot rate. Here’s what you can expect in Columbus:

  • Base rate: Starts around $100 for a small load (approximately 2‑3 cubic feet).
  • Medium loads: $200‑$300 for typical home clean‑outs.
  • Large projects: $400+ for extensive renovations or commercial pickups.

All prices include:

  • Labor (no hidden labor fees)
  • Loading and hauling
  • Eco‑friendly disposal or donation
  • Cleanup of the work area

Special items such as appliances, mattresses, or electronics may incur a small surcharge, but these are always disclosed before the crew begins loading.

What Types of Junk Can Be Removed?

From everyday clutter to bulky construction debris, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? handles a wide range of items. Below is a quick checklist for Columbus customers:

  • Furniture (couches, tables, chairs)
  • Appliances (refrigerators, washers, dryers)
  • Electronics (TVs, computers, gaming consoles)
  • Yard waste (branches, mulch, old garden equipment)
  • Renovation debris (drywall, tiles, lumber)
  • Office equipment (desks, filing cabinets, printers)
  • Miscellaneous junk (old toys, sports gear, broken items)

Items that are hazardous (asbestos, chemicals, tires) are not accepted, but the team will gladly point you toward a local disposal facility that can handle them safely.

Tips for Preparing Your Junk

While 1-800-GOT-JUNK? does all the heavy lifting, a little prep on your part can speed up the process and potentially lower the cost:

  1. Gather items together: Group similar items (e.g., all furniture in one room) so the crew can load efficiently.
  2. Clear pathways: Ensure there’s a clear route from the pickup point to the truck—remove rugs, cords, or obstacles.
  3. Separate recyclables: If you have clean cardboard, paper, or metal, set them aside. The team can often recycle these directly.
  4. Disassemble large pieces: Breaking down a bed frame or table can reduce the volume needed, which may lower your price.
  5. Secure valuable items: Double‑check that you haven’t left behind anything you want to keep, like important documents or heirlooms.
